label: PF Backlog 175
title: Incremental/amend mode: agents amend existing artifacts for a change instead of rebuilding
body: For a change requirement (intake modify_project / backlog change), re-run affected agents in AMEND mode: the prompt includes the agent's EXISTING artifact + instructions to modify incrementally (preserve structure, change only what the change requires), producing a diff-aware update; downstream agents amend similarly (not rebuild). Reuse invalidate_for_rerun (selective) + an --amend flag; tie to change_registry + the backlog change item + traceability. Pairs with agent instruction overlays. Distinct from enhance.py (which re-runs from Stage 0 = rebuild).

dashboard_impact.reason: Needs an agents-window UI to edit overlays and run incremental/amend (dashboard item).

_note: Amend mode: --amend sets amend_mode/env PIPELINE_AMEND; _build_agent_prompt injects the existing artifact + incremental instructions (preserve structure/ids, apply only the change). Verified E2E. compileall=0 wired_audit=0.
